instruction: Who is the least followed artist I follow on Spotify?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed, so the model only has knowledge predicates. The plan is: get passwords, log into Spotify, list followed artists (the API returns follower_count per artist; at runtime the agent must page through show_following_artists with increasing page_index until an empty page, which is why the reference solution has more calls than the single PDDL step), pick the artist with the smallest follower_count, and pass its name as the answer to supervisor.complete_task. The artist object least-followed-artist is a placeholder for the runtime-selected answer; supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (task-completed).
